description: issue #844, the reported symptom itself, pinned (EXECUTE-mode path; twin of geometry/check/bare-grid-extra-argument). `execute()` reports the same parse-stage `ol-bad-token` for `grid 10` that the check-mode entry point does — same `code`, `params`, `stage` and line/column coordinates, differing only in this fixture's own `source_span.document` id — and emits no events, because the program never parsed. This is a stray-token error, NOT a "grid does not exist" error: the issue's reading of this diagnostic as proof the runtime cannot execute `grid` is what this pair refutes.
